purpose: Teach: 東日本/東亜/堺/生き残り/脳裏/紡/転生/テクスト

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、東日本大震災後の心的ケアを医療チームで継続しております
lines.en: Ren, our medical team continues to provide psychological care for survivors in the aftermath of the Great East Japan Earthquake.
lines.style: Steady, composed opening. Clear enunciation on medical terms. Measured pace—not rushed, but professional. Slight weight on the commitment in 'continues.' No warmth, no coldness; purely clear.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、東亜地域の医療連携を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Ren, we're advancing medical coordination across the East Asia region as a team.
lines.style: Same professional baseline. Slight emphasis on 'advancing'—forward momentum. Calm but not passive. Clinical precision without distance.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、堺市の地域医療と医療チームで連携します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team is partnering with local healthcare services in Sakai.
lines.style: Steady tone, consistent with the previous lines. Brief pause before 'local'—grounding the focus to the specific place. Clear, unhurried.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、災害の生き残りの方々の長期ケアを医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team provides long-term care for disaster survivors.
lines.style: Slight deepening in tone—the weight of 'long-term' settles. Not heavier, but more deliberate. Still composed. A hint of the seriousness behind the work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の脳裏に残るトラウマを医療チームで丁寧に支援します
lines.en: Ren, we support our patients through the trauma that lingers in their minds with careful attention from our entire team.
lines.style: Quieter attack on 'support.' Slower pace here—this is the tender underbelly beneath the clinical language. Careful enunciation on 'lingers.' Warm without softening.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療チームで時間を紡ぐ、つまり地道な診療を続けます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team weaves time together through steady, thoughtful care—that's the foundation of what we do.
lines.style: Slight metaphorical shift in the voice. Less clipped, more flowing on 'weaves.' Breath underneath. A moment of poetry within professionalism. Slower, more present.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、終末期医療と転生観の関係を医療チームで尊重します
lines.en: Ren, we respect the connection between end-of-life care and patients' spiritual beliefs as a medical team.
lines.style: Respectful weight on 'spiritual beliefs'—not clinical distance, but reverent professionalism. Steady pacing. Acknowledgment of something larger than medicine.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、診療テクスト、つまり医療文書の標準化を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Ren, we're standardizing medical documentation as a team—moving toward clearer, more consistent care.
lines.style: Returning to crisp clarity. 'Standardizing' lands with precision. Final line: slightly lighter closing, almost conclusive. Professional completion without abruptness.
